name: Animal Battle Stats
pitch: Collect all 225 real animals as holo-cards, power them up, and settle who would win in flashy 3D battles on floating islands.

features.title: Collect 225 real animals
features.text: Every animal on this site is a real-photo holo-card in the game, from army ants to the Megalodon.

features.title: Battle in a 3D world
features.text: Fly your champion card across eight biome islands (Savanna, Forest, Jungle, Wetlands, Desert, Mountains, Arctic and Ocean) and fight wild animals where they live.

features.title: Goofy power-scaling
features.text: Hordes and crowd battles settle the classics: 100 army ants against a honey badger, or 30 wolves against an elephant.

features.title: Live shows and tournaments
features.text: Server-wide Who Would Win? shows, 8-animal tournaments, raids against giant crowds and a daily gauntlet, played out on the Plaza stage for everyone at once.

features.title: Real stats drive the fights
features.text: Attack, defense, agility and the rest come straight from this database, so research on the site changes the game.

features.title: No loot boxes
features.text: No packs, no paid odds and nothing you can buy that makes an animal stronger. Rewards come from playing.
